home:streak.days: {count, plural, =0 {No streak yet} one {# day streak} other {# day streak}}
home:streak.days__note: ICU plural — Swedish and German need forms English does not have.
home:goal.progress__note: The user's daily goal, in lessons rather than minutes — lessons are the unit they actually experience. Both are whole numbers. Never framed as falling behind.
home:goal.met: {count, plural, one {# lesson today — goal met} other {# lessons today — goal met}}
home:goal.met__note: Shown once the daily goal is reached. Congratulates without telling the user to stop; passing the goal is a good thing, not an end.
home:quest.today__note: Card title on Home for the day's quest. Max 18 chars.
home:friends.online: {count, plural, =0 {No friends online} one {# friend online} other {# friends online}}
home:friends.online__note: Count of friends currently online. ICU plural.
home:progress.mastered__note: Label on the mastery progress bar. Max 18 chars.
home:level__note: Label on the XP bar. {level} is a whole number.
home:stats.label: Your progress
home:stats.label__note: Accessibility label grouping the stats card into one element.
home:stats.xp__note: Accessibility label for the XP chip. Spoken, so a full phrase.
home:stats.coins__note: Accessibility label for the coin chip.
home:stats.gems__note: Accessibility label for the gem chip. Gems are the premium currency and the chip is hidden while the balance is zero, so this is only ever read with a real number in it.
home:greeting.morning__note: Salutation line 1. The role follows on line 2.
home:greeting.role__note: Line 2 of the greeting. The user's role, not their name.
home:streak.label: Day streak
home:streak.label__note: Caption under the streak count. Max 12 chars.
home:avatar.label: Your profile
home:avatar.label__note: Accessibility label for the avatar button.
home:streak.chip: {count, plural, =0 {Your streak: no days yet} one {Your streak: # day} other {Your streak: # days}}
home:streak.chip__note: Spoken label of the flame chip at the top of every tab, which opens the streak page. The zero case is neutral, never a nudge.
home:quest.progress__note: Label on the quest progress bar.
home:friends.title: Friends
home:friends.label: Friends
home:friends.label__note: Accessibility label grouping the friends tile.
home:league.title: League
home:league.closed__note: Shown on the Home league tile while Leagues are unbuilt (v2.0). Deliberately carries NO date and no teaser — a promise with a month attached is a promise to break. It replaced an em-dash, which is a missing value rather than an empty state. Max 16 characters.
home:league.label: League standing
home:league.label__note: Accessibility label grouping the league tile.
home:world.title: Your world
home:world.title__note: Card title on Home summarising overall progress. Max 16 characters.
home:world.label: Your world progress
home:world.label__note: Accessibility label grouping the Home world card.
home:world.countries__note: Countries FINISHED (every quizzable fact mastered) out of those the packs contain. Whole numbers.
home:world.facts__note: Label on the Home world progress bar, and what a screen reader announces as its value. Counts facts, not countries, so the bar moves every session.
home:world.due: {count, plural, one {# fact ready to review} other {# facts ready to review}}
home:world.due__note: Shown only when at least one fact is due. ICU plural. "Ready to review" rather than "overdue" or "waiting" — a spaced-repetition prompt must never read as a debt the user has fallen behind on.
home:world.open__note: The row at the foot of the Home world card, opening the continents grid. It was "Explore" while it was a small button squeezed into the card's padding; as a full-width row there is space to say what it opens, and a row labelled with one word next to a chevron makes the reader guess. Max 22 characters.
home:quest.play: Five challenges at your own pace
home:quest.play__note: Phase 1 claim review, 2026-09-13. Describe current practice/account availability without promising retention, complete world coverage or cross-device recovery. Keep ICU placeholders unchanged.
home:quest.done__note: Replaces the title once all five tasks are finished. A statement, not a celebration — the lesson summary already celebrated. Max 20 characters.
home:quest.doneBody: Your streak is safe. Keep going if you want more.
home:quest.doneBody__note: The bar's label once the quest is done. Says the day's obligation is discharged AND that more is optional — finishing has to be enough. Max 60 characters.
home:quest.more__note: Secondary button shown only after the quest is complete, for someone who wants another lesson. Deliberately not a second primary action. Max 20 characters.
home:facts.streak__note: Value of the streak tile in the row of three under the greeting. The label above it already says 'Day streak', so this is the count and its unit only. Reads 0 days on a fresh account, which is a fact about today rather than a verdict.
home:facts.rank__note: Label of the middle tile in the row of three under the greeting. Its value is the earned title — Wanderer, Scout — not a league position. Max 10 characters.
home:facts.quests__note: Value of the quests tile in the row of three under the greeting: tasks done out of tasks set today. Both are whole numbers.
home:quest.reward.xp__note: Accessibility label for the XP chip on the daily quest card. Says what finishing the quest pays. {amount} is a whole number.
home:quest.reward.coins__note: Accessibility label for the coin chip on the daily quest card. {amount} is a whole number.
home:quest.resets__note: Countdown on the daily quest card — how long until today's quest resets. Both are whole numbers; hours can be 0.
home:reminder.title: Want a nudge?
home:reminder.title__note: Heading on the card that asks permission to send the daily reminder. An offer, never a push. Max 24 characters.
home:reminder.body: One reminder a day, at a time you choose. Nothing else, ever.
home:reminder.body__note: Under the heading. States the whole deal so the user can say yes without wondering what else arrives. Max 70 characters.
home:reminder.yes__note: Accepts. Opens the phone's notification permission dialogue. Max 14 characters.
home:reminder.later__note: Dismisses the card. NOT 'No thanks' — nothing has been refused, and we may ask once more in ninety days. Max 12 characters.
home:streakNotice.freeze.title: {count, plural, one {Your streak freeze kept your # day streak} other {Your streak freeze kept your # day streak}}
home:streakNotice.freeze.title__note: Card on Home the day after a streak freeze covered a missed day. {count} is the streak's length. Warm and factual — the freeze did its job. Never say what would have happened without it. ICU plural: Swedish needs 'dags' and 'dagars'.
home:streakNotice.freeze.body__note: Under the freeze card's heading. What happened, calmly. Not 'you missed a day', and no nudge to buy another freeze.
home:streakNotice.repair.title: {count, plural, one {You can bring back your # day streak} other {You can bring back your # day streak}}
home:streakNotice.repair.title__note: Card on Home while a broken streak can still be repaired and the learner has the coins. {count} is the length a repair restores. An offer, stated plainly: no countdown, no 'before it's too late', no loss words. ICU plural.
home:streakNotice.repair.body__note: Under the repair card's heading. The price before the tap, so the next screen holds no surprise. {price} is a whole number of coins, always more than one.
home:streakNotice.repair.cta__note: Button on the repair card. Opens the streak screen, where the repair is bought — this button buys nothing itself. Max 16 characters.
home:streakNotice.dismiss__note: Accessibility label for the X on the streak card. The action, not the icon. Hides this card for good.
home:path.unit__note: Small label above a unit's title on the Home course path. {number} is the unit's position, from 1. Drawn in capitals by the style, not by the string. Max 12 characters.
home:path.unit.heading: Unit {number}: {title}
home:path.unit.heading__note: What a screen reader announces for a unit header, as one heading: the small label and the title together. {title} is the unit's title, already translated.
home:path.unit.progress__note: How many steps of this unit are finished, on the unit header's progress bar. Whole numbers. A count, never framed as falling behind.
home:path.start__note: Callout over the current step on the Home course path — the one primary action on Home. Verb, imperative. Drawn in capitals by the style. Max 10 characters.
home:path.lesson__note: Under the current step's objective: which lesson of the step is next. {lesson} counts from 1; {lessons} is how many finished lessons complete the step.
home:path.node.current__note: Screen-reader label of the current step, a button that starts its lesson. {objective} is a whole sentence ending in a full stop (the step's objective, already translated). {position} and {total}: the step's place in the whole course.
home:path.node.done__note: Screen-reader label of a finished step. Pressing it opens a card offering practice. {objective} is a whole sentence.
home:path.node.locked__note: Screen-reader label of a step that is not open yet. Pressing it explains how it opens. Factual — never 'locked out'. {objective} is a whole sentence.
home:path.done.body: You finished this step. Practise it any time.
home:path.done.body__note: In the card that opens under a finished step, above its Practise button. Max 60 characters.
home:path.practise__note: Button in the card under a finished step: replays that step's lesson. Verb, imperative. Deliberately not a second primary action. Max 14 characters.
home:path.locked.body: Not open yet. It opens when you finish the steps before it.
home:path.locked.body__note: In the card that opens under a step that is not open yet. Says how it opens; no 'locked', no 'you must'. Max 70 characters.
home:path.complete.title: You finished {course}.
home:path.complete.title__note: Heading of the card that follows the path once every step is done. {course} is the course's name, e.g. 'World foundations'. Satisfied rather than triumphant: no exclamation mark.
home:path.complete.body: There's nothing new on this path. Reviewing keeps what you learned fresh.
home:path.complete.body__note: Under the heading above. Honest that the course has ended — never implies endless new content — and says what the button does. Max 90 characters.
home:path.review__note: The one primary button once the course is finished: a lesson over everything the course taught, what is due first. Max 18 characters.
home:path.error.title: The course didn't load
home:path.error.title__note: Heading where the course path would be, when the course could not be read. A fact, not an apology. Max 32 characters.
home:path.error.body: Lessons still work, so you can practise now.
home:path.error.body__note: Under the heading above: what still works, leading to the button. Max 60 characters.
home:path.error.cta__note: Button when the course did not load: starts an ordinary lesson. Max 16 characters.
